# Custom instructions for GitHub Copilot

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) in the repository root. It is the single
source of truth for this project: commands, layout, code style, testing rules,
commit conventions, pinned dependency versions and the release process.

These instructions are intentionally a pointer rather than a copy. The previous
version restated the rules and went stale — it still advertised ESLint months
after the project had moved to Biome.
